items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I think we were both influenced by Frank Trumbauer, pretty much.

ctx.x: Can you comment on your kind of alliance in your sound with Johnny Hodges? People have always mentioned that.
Oh, yes, of course. But I think we were both influenced by Frank Trumbauer, pretty much.
